name: Spellcasting
summary: Prepare and cast Artificer spells with Intelligence, using Artisan’s Tools as your spellcasting focus.
description:
You prepare Artificer spells according to the Artificer Features table. Your prepared spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace any prepared Artificer spells with other eligible Artificer spells. Spells that another Artificer feature always prepares do not count against this total.

Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for Artificer spells. You use Artisan’s Tools as the Spellcasting Focus for them. The **Mending** cantrip is always prepared for you and does not count against your normal cantrip total.
source: Artificer level 1 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Tinker’s Magic
summary: Use Tinker’s Tools to create a temporary piece of useful adventuring gear.
description:
While holding Tinker’s Tools, you can take a Magic action to create one item in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of yourself. Choose: Ball Bearings, Basket, Bedroll, Bell, Blanket, Block and Tackle, Bottle (Glass), Bucket, Caltrops, Candle, Crowbar, Flask, Grappling Hook, Hunting Trap, Jug, Lamp, Manacles, Net, Oil, Paper, Parchment, Pole, Pouch, Rope, Sack, Shovel, Spikes (Iron), String, Tinderbox, Torch, or Vial.

The item lasts until you finish a Long Rest, when it vanishes. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses after a Long Rest.
source: Artificer level 1 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Replicate Magic Item
summary: Learn magic-item plans and create a limited number of temporary magic items after each Long Rest.
description:
When you gain this feature, you learn four plans from the level 2+ list. Whenever you gain an Artificer level, you can replace one known plan with another for which you qualify. Your capacity increases at levels 6, 10, 14, and 18: **4 plans/2 items**, **5/3**, **6/4**, **7/5**, then **8/6**.

After a Long Rest, while holding Tinker’s Tools, you can create magic items based on different plans you know. You may immediately attune to a created item. If you exceed your item limit, the oldest created item vanishes. A created item otherwise functions normally, lasts until 1d4 days after your death, and vanishes immediately if you replace its plan. Contents of a vanished container appear harmlessly nearby. Any Wand or Weapon created this way can serve as your Artificer Spellcasting Focus.

**Level 2+ plans:** Alchemy Jug; Bag of Holding; Cap of Water Breathing; an eligible Common magic item; Goggles of Night; Manifold Tool; Repeating Shot; Returning Weapon; Rope of Climbing; Sending Stones; Shield +1; Wand of Magic Detection; Wand of Secrets; Wand of the War Mage +1; Weapon +1; Wraps of Unarmed Power +1.

**Level 6+ plans:** Armor +1; Boots of Elvenkind; Boots of the Winding Path; Cloak of Elvenkind; Cloak of the Manta Ray; Dazzling Weapon; Eyes of Charming; Eyes of Minute Seeing; Gloves of Thievery; Helm of Awareness; Lantern of Revealing; Mind Sharpener; Necklace of Adaptation; Pipes of Haunting; Repulsion Shield; Ring of Swimming; Ring of Water Walking; Sentinel Shield; Spell-Refueling Ring; Wand of Magic Missiles; Wand of Web; Weapon of Warning.

**Level 10+ plans:** Armor of Resistance; Dagger of Venom; Elven Chain; Ring of Feather Falling; Ring of Jumping; Ring of Mind Shielding; Shield +2; an eligible Uncommon Wondrous Item; Wand of the War Mage +2; Weapon +2; Wraps of Unarmed Power +2.

**Level 14+ plans:** Armor +2; Arrow-Catching Shield; Flame Tongue; an eligible Rare Wondrous Item; Ring of Free Action; Ring of Protection; Ring of the Ram.

Generic-item plans cannot be Potions, Scrolls, or cursed items. Plans marked as repeatable in the book may be learned more than once for different items.
source: Artificer level 2 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Ability Score Improvement
summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.
description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Artificer levels 8, 12, and 16.
source: Artificer level 4 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Magic Item Tinker
summary: Charge, drain, or transmute magic items created with Replicate Magic Item.
description:
Your Replicate Magic Item feature gains three options.

**Charge Magic Item.** As a Bonus Action, touch a created magic item with charges within 5 feet and expend a level 1+ spell slot. The item regains charges equal to the slot’s level.

**Drain Magic Item.** As a Bonus Action, touch one of your created items within 5 feet and make it vanish, converting its energy into a spell slot: level 1 for a Common item or level 2 for an Uncommon or Rare item. You can do this once per Long Rest, and the created slot vanishes when you finish a Long Rest.

**Transmute Magic Item.** As a Magic action, touch one of your created items within 5 feet and transform it into a different item based on a plan you know. You can do this once per Long Rest.
source: Artificer level 6 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Flash of Genius
summary: Add your Intelligence modifier to a failed ability check or saving throw within 30 feet.
description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet fails an ability check or saving throw, take a Reaction to add your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses after a Long Rest. Advanced Artifice improves its recovery at level 14.
source: Artificer level 7 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Magic Item Adept
summary: You can attune to as many as four magic items at once.
description: Your maximum number of simultaneously attuned magic items increases to four.
source: Artificer level 10 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Spell-Storing Item
summary: Store a level 1–3 Artificer spell in a weapon or spellcasting-focus item for repeated use.
description:
After a Long Rest, touch a Simple or Martial weapon or an item usable as a Spellcasting Focus and store one level 1, 2, or 3 Artificer spell in it. The spell must have a casting time of an action and no consumed Material component; it need not be prepared.

A creature holding the item can take a Magic action to produce the spell’s effect using your spellcasting ability modifier. That creature supplies any required Concentration. After a creature uses the item, it cannot do so again until the start of its next turn. The spell remains until used a number of times equal to twice your Intelligence modifier (minimum twice), or until you store another spell with this feature.
source: Artificer level 11 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Advanced Artifice
summary: Attune to five magic items and recover one Flash of Genius use after a Short Rest.
description: You can now attune to as many as five magic items at once. In addition, whenever you finish a Short Rest, you regain one expended use of Flash of Genius.
source: Artificer level 14 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Magic Item Master
summary: You can attune to as many as six magic items at once.
description: Your maximum number of simultaneously attuned magic items increases to six.
source: Artificer level 18 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Epic Boon
summary: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.
description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Energy Resistance is recommended.
source: Artificer level 19 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)

name: Soul of Artifice
summary: Sacrifice replicated items to survive at 0 HP and recover Flash of Genius through your attunements.
description:
You gain two benefits.

**Cheat Death.** If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, you can disintegrate any number of Uncommon or Rare magic items created by Replicate Magic Item. Your Hit Points become 20 times the number of items disintegrated.

**Magical Guidance.** Whenever you finish a Short Rest while attuned to at least one magic item, you regain every expended use of Flash of Genius.
source: Artificer level 20 · Eberron: Forge of the Artificer (2025)
